Fourteen paths invoke underlying C packages from C++17, while CImg, Boost.GIL, wxWidgets, QtBase, pnm++, and OpenImageIO are native C++ PNM readers. CImg 4.0.5 misreads the original valid P3 control when maxval occupies a separate line, so its adapter uses a second valid P3 control with dimensions and maxval on the same line; the verifier records both outcomes and makes no full P3 conformance claim. Boost.GIL parses the original control directly. SDL2_image and SDL3_image share one upstream family and star count; libpnmrw and Netpbm share PBMPLUS ancestry.
